name: Gmail OTP Filler Cross-Browser Distribution
description: Maintain the Chrome release and deliver a privately signed Firefox variant.

stories.title: Restore Codebase and Load Extension
stories.description: Restore the OTP filler codebase, update the Chrome manifest, load it, and deploy the privacy policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Privacy policy deployed to GitHub Pages.

stories.title: Package and Privately Sign Firefox Extension
stories.description: Create a Firefox MV3 variant, preserve Gmail OAuth and automatic OTP filling, validate it, and obtain an unlisted AMO-signed XPI.
acceptanceCriteria: Firefox manifest has a stable Gecko add-on ID and valid data declarations.
Firefox OAuth redirect is deterministic and documented.
web-ext lint returns zero errors, notices, and warnings.
Unlisted AMO signing returns a permanent-install XPI.
Signed XPI completes Gmail login and OTP form smoke testing.
blockedBy: Firefox OAuth redirect URI must be added to the Google Cloud client.
AMO_API_KEY and AMO_API_SECRET are required for signing.
Signed XPI is required for the final Firefox smoke test.
